info.title: Zanshin API
info.description: Self-hosted LiveOps platform: client API (`/v1`, per-player sessions), server API (`/server/v1`, trusted backends such as Nakama) and admin API (`/admin/v1`, console and automation). Client and server endpoints are fully typed here; admin endpoints are listed with their permission model — field-level documentation lives in docs/api.md.

tags.name: Client API
tags.description: Per-player calls authenticated with a session token obtained from /v1/authenticate (client API key `zk_c_…`).

tags.name: Server API
tags.description: Trusted backend calls with a server API key (`zk_s_…`), addressing players by `external_id`.

post.description: Core events (`sessionStart`, `purchaseCompleted`, `adImpression`, …) have frozen schemas; unknown events are discovered or rejected per taxonomy settings. Rejected inputs become `$event_error`.

delete.summary: Delete a message from the inbox

get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket with `?token=<access token>&names=a,b`. Frames: `{type: hello|flag|flag_deleted|flags|experiments|live_events|inbox|pong|error, ...}`; send `{"type":"ping"}` every 30 s. Close code 4401 = token expired.

get.summary: Rules bundle for local evaluation in server SDKs
get.description: Every flag definition plus the dynamic audiences they reference; managed audiences are listed by key only. Same bucketing / operators / reasons as the server.
